items.prompt1: Summarize research over the past 3 years on [tumor-associated macrophages and resistance to immunotherapy], including major mechanisms, representative studies, and current controversies.
items.prompt2: Explain the clinical significance of the EGFR [L858R] mutation in non-small cell lung cancer, including targeted therapies, treatment outcomes, and common resistance mechanisms.
items.prompt3: Compare the strengths, limitations, and use cases of [single-cell RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, and single-cell multi-omics] for studying the tumor microenvironment.
items.prompt4: I want to study [aging and mitochondrial dysfunction]. Identify key reviews, representative studies, and unresolved questions in this field.

items.prompt5: Summarize the current state of research on [resistance to KRAS G12C-targeted therapy] and identify 3 questions worth investigating further.
items.prompt6: I want to study [T cell exhaustion in liver cancer]. Propose specific, testable hypotheses and explain the evidence behind each one.
items.prompt7: Identify potential research gaps concerning [obesity and the tumor immune microenvironment], and assess which directions merit further investigation.
items.prompt8: I am interested in [drought resistance mechanisms in Arabidopsis]. Break this broad topic into feasible research questions.

items.prompt9: I want to use TCGA data to study [whether TP53 mutations affect prognosis in lung adenocarcinoma]. Design an analysis plan covering data, methods, statistical tests, and figures.
items.prompt10: Design a complete workflow to compare [transcriptomic differences between lung cancer and normal tissue], from public data acquisition and quality control to differential expression and pathway enrichment.
items.prompt11: I want to study [T cell exhaustion in liver cancer] using public single-cell data. Plan the analysis, including cell annotation, key markers, differential expression, and functional validation.
items.prompt12: If differential expression analysis finds many upregulated immune-related genes, what analyses should follow to identify the specific immune cells or pathways involved?

items.prompt13: Write a research background paragraph for a paper Introduction on [tumor-associated macrophages and resistance to immunotherapy], citing key supporting literature.
items.prompt14: Create a review outline on [applications of single-cell spatial transcriptomics in cancer research], including sections and the key topics to discuss in each.
items.prompt15: Assuming a study finds [significantly lower overall survival in patients with TP53 mutations], write a Results paragraph in the style of a medical paper.
items.prompt16: Write a Discussion paragraph based on current research on [resistance to KRAS G12C-targeted therapy], covering possible mechanisms, limitations, and future directions.
